title: Perfumer: A Large Language Model-based Agentic Framework Accelerating Structural Relaxation and Electronic Band Prediction for First-Principle Calculation
abstract: arXiv:2611.26349v1 Announce Type: cross  Abstract: First-principles structural relaxation and band calculations require substantial computation and expertise. Here we present Perfumer, a large language model-based agentic framework that couples Quantum ESPRESSO with two predictive models. Across tested structures, pre-relaxation with Perfumer-relax model followed by QE refinement yielded a 2.75-fold overall speedup over QE alone. Perfumer-band model combines a periodic graph neural network with a latent Hermitian spectral head returns 12 band energies at any requested wavevector, preserving reciprocal lattice periodicity and time-reversal symmetry without constructing Hamiltonian. translated_title: Perfumer：一种基于大语言模型的智能体框架，用于加速第一性原理计算中的结构弛豫与电子能带预测
translated_abstract: 第一性原理结构弛豫与能带计算需要大量的计算资源和专业知识。本文提出了Perfumer，一个基于大语言模型的智能体框架，它将Quantum ESPRESSO与两个预测模型相结合。在所测试的结构上，先使用Perfumer-relax模型进行预弛豫、再经QE精细优化，相比单独使用QE实现了2.75倍的总体加速。Perfumer-band模型将周期图神经网络与潜在的厄米特谱头相结合，可在任意请求的波矢处返回12条能带能量，在无需构建哈密顿量的情况下保持倒格子周期性和时间反演对称性。该模型在125,153个自建的能带结构数据集上训练，在来自涵盖85种元素的留出成分族的2,607个测试材料（包括镧系、锕系和磁性化合物）上，单材料平均绝对误差的中位数达到0.157 eV，每个材料仅需约97毫秒……
tldr: Perfumer是一个基于大语言模型的智能体框架，通过结构预弛豫使第一性原理计算实现2.75倍加速，其能带预测模型可快速准确地预测电子能带（中位误差0.157 eV，每材料仅约97毫秒）。
en_tdlr: Perfumer is an LLM-based agentic framework that achieves a 2.75-fold speedup for first-principles structural relaxation and rapidly predicts band energies with a 0.157 eV median MAE at about 97 ms per material.
